_help.about: The torch (design 30 Sept §AW): a burning brand carried in one hand, the first tool. Unlit until held to a flame (a lit fire, a planted torch, another torch); burns about one night; a point light with Minecraft-style falloff; can be planted in the ground. Restart after editing.
_help.burn_min: Real minutes a torch burns at full flame (the equatorial night is 48).
_help.gutter_share: The last share of its life it spends guttering: dimmer, harder flicker, the warning to head for a fire.
_help.rain_burn_scale: Burn-time multiplier in rain (storm: storm_burn_scale). douse_depth_m: water this deep puts it out.
_help.light: range_m / energy / attenuation: the falloff. gutter_energy: energy while guttering. flicker_hz / flicker_amount: the slow flicker; sprinting and wind scale it. shadows false: no shadow map from a torch (§AG).
_help.planted: Right click the ground with a lit torch to stand it up; take it back within pickup_reach_m.
_help.lighting_reach_m: How close to a flame the torch must be held to light.
_help.bundle: Unlit torches by a camp's fire (§AW): how many, and how many game hours until the folk have made more.
_help.climb: Starting a climb with a lit torch plants it if there is ground to plant it in, otherwise it goes out (stowing puts it out; relight at a flame).
_help.resin: The resin torch's block (technique resin_torch): see resin._note.
_help.swing: (design §CN) The swing passes the flame. Left click (button: the item-in-hand action, "shoot") with the torch in hand swings it: the bare-hand swing's arc and timing (fists.gd, use_fist_arc), with the torch in the hand. At the end of the arc the flame passes between whatever it touches within reach_m (the same as lighting_reach_m), lit to unlit, either way (passes_flame): a lit torch lights a laid fire (fuel.json kindling), embers, a laid delve fire-holder (delves.json) or a planted torch (lights); an unlit torch swung through a lit fire, a lit fire-holder or a planted torch catches (takes_from). Sharing a flame costs the torch nothing (share_cost_min 0): its own burn is still the clock. It never lights the ground, standing grass, camp structures, folk or creatures (never_lights): wildfire's ignition stays a torch dropped in dry grass (§BL). A swing at a creature does nothing (creature_effect none): they answer to fire, not to the swing (§BA). Supersedes §AW's lighting ritual and the old hearths' right click (right_click_lights false): right click goes back to plain interact. log: the lines it adds to the log (§AZ).

resin._note: Design 30 Sept §BP resin torch (technique resin_torch): dipped in pine pitch it burns burn_scale times as long, energy_scale as bright, shrugs off drizzle (rain_immune) and only a storm shortens it. First guesses by Claude Code 1 Oct; the designer owns them.

log.kindling_wet: The kindling smokes and won't catch.
